name: Microsoft Outlook Suggestion Sources
packageArguments: Required base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON object. Every value is a JSON string. Pass {"Match":"personal.stale@example.invalid"} (eyJNYXRjaCI6InBlcnNvbmFsLnN0YWxlQGV4YW1wbGUuaW52YWxpZCJ9), or add any of "Hours":"168" (event log window, default 72, cap 720), "Scope":"browser" (all, browser, outlook, office; default all), and "Sections":"roots,config" (all, none, or a comma list of processes, config, roots, inventory, roamcache; default all, or processes,config,roots for browser and office).
